shared_elements: depiction of ornament or headgear on a figure
justification: Both depict human figures engaging with objects — A a single three-dimensional standing warrior brandishing a raised weapon/trophy and holding a shield, B a low-relief scene of two seated figures facing each other across an offering table beneath registers of sign-like inscription. Beyond the generic presence of humans and held objects, nothing corresponds: A is a fully modelled, naturalistically proportioned free-standing figure in dramatic upward-gazing action, while B is a flat, schematic profile composition organised in horizontal registers with writing, an arrangement and convention utterly unlike A's.
